description: Submit a Gaussian 16 quantum chemistry job on 2 nodes with 16 tasks per node, 64GB memory per node, and a wall time of 168 hours (7 days). The script loads the Gaussian module, sets scratch and memory environment variables, and runs a Gaussian geometry optimization calculation for a transition state search using input file catalyst_ts.com.

workload_class.step_description: Load Gaussian module, set scratch and memory environment variables, and run Gaussian 16 on the input file catalyst_ts.com, outputting to catalyst_ts.log.
